description: Defines the PlayerInfo class, including nested Notification and DolbyNotification classes, with methods for plugin initialization, deinitialization, web request handling, and Dolby output notifications within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: PlayerInfo
classes.description: Main plugin class implementing plugin, web, and JSONRPC interfaces, managing player state, notifications, and Dolby output interactions.

classes.name: Notification
classes.description: Handles remote connection activation and deactivation notifications.

classes.name: DolbyNotification
classes.description: Handles Dolby output notifications, including initialization, deinitialization, and audio mode changes.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the given service shell.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the plugin from the given service shell.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns plugin information as a string.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Processes web requests and returns responses.
